[[Mallyx's Spite]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] that can be obtained after defeating [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] in [[the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

==Acquisition==
;[[Guild Wars Nightfall]]
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**[[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]]
***[[Citadel Chest]]

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell|spells]] (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Bone Idol]] from collector [[Endah]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Soul Reaping]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Bone Idol]] from collector [[Danira]]
**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Focus]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Serenity Now]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Soul Reaping]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Bone Idol]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Necromantic Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]

==Unique counterparts==
* [[Focus of the Hierophant]] and [[Rot's Putrescence]] have stats identical to this item.
* [[Imperial Dragon Focus]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
